what: A piano keyboard canvas spanning the screen width (88 keys, four octaves under 700px width). A hovered key lights faintly (+.14), and a pressed or drag-swept key lights amber at 1 and plays a short note. All glow cools ×.93 per frame, and when idle, every 70 frames a random key in the middle range lights itself at .28. Glow darkness goes .95→.15 from top to bottom, with an 18px blur

options.decay: Light ratio left in a frame, default .93
options.idle: Interval for automatic turn-on (frames), default 70 — 0 means off
options.narrow: Below this width (px) only four octaves, default 700
options.sound: If off, lights only, no sound
options.--fx-height: Key height (set via style), default 92px · 120px on wide screens

use: <canvas data-fx="glow-piano-keys" role="img" aria-label="Piano keys you can press to play"></canvas>
note: Colors are read at attach time from --kf-ink (key border) · --kf-raised (black keys) · --kf-accent-text → --kf-accent (light). This part is meant for use on a dark skin. The original lights the keys from that song’s note data when a song plays (there is no data file, so this part runs only by hand and on its own).

from.where: index.html .m-piano (Hero bottom) — original Teclado (decay .93, idle 70 frames .28, hover .14, 21~108/36~83)
